{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
# First, check if there are any non-numeric values in revenue
print("Unique revenue values:", data['revenue'].unique()[:10])  # Show first 10

# Replace commas and convert to float
data['revenue'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check for QA orders (expected to be 6, but not found in previous check)
qa_orders = data[data['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print("QA orders found:", qa_orders.shape[0])

# Remove QA orders if any
if qa_orders.shape[0] > 0:
    data = data[~data['revenue'].isin([999999.99])]

# Remove refunded orders (status == 'refunded')
# Conversion rate is only for completed orders
completed_orders = data[data['status'] == 'completed']

# Calculate conversion rate by customer_segment
conversion_rate_by_segment = completed_orders.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean() * 100

# Find the segment with the highest conversion rate
highest_conversion_segment = conversion_rate_by_segment.idxmax()

# Print the conversion rates
print("Conversion rates by customer_segment (completed orders only):")
print(conversion_rate_by_segment)

# Return the highest segment
highest_conversion_segment"}
